'''Prickle berry''' is an [[above ground|aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can be [[food|eaten]], [[cooking|cooked]], or [[brewing|brewed]]. However, it is not as [[Alcohol#List_of_alcohol|delicious]] as any of the [[underground]] crops.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] prickle berries for their ''precise thorns''.
